Design, consume, and support REST APIs, including request and response handling, authentication, input validation, error handling, logging, and integration testing. Contribute to AI-enabled application development using AWS Bedrock, including model invocation, prompt implementation, response processing, guardrails, and integration with enterprise applications. Assist in building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge-base, document-processing, semantic-search, and chat-with-data capabilities using approved data sources and access controls. Use relevant AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS/Aurora, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, CloudWatch, IAM, Secrets Manager, KMS, and Bedrock to support cloud-native applications. Create unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot defects, and follow secure coding, source-control, CI/CD, and software-development standards. Work with business analysts, product owners, developers, testers, and support teams to understand requirements and deliver reliable technical solutions. Create and maintain technical documentation, including API specifications, data mappings, implementation notes, support procedures, and knowledge articles. Provide production-support assistance by reviewing logs, analyzing application or data issues, documenting findings, and escalating complex problems to the appropriate teams. Follow applicable information-security, data-protection, responsible AI, change-management, and operational-risk requirements when handling banking data and AI-enabled functionality. Job Requirements: Bachelors’ Degree (or foreign equivalent degree) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Experience in the financial services or banking industry is preferred. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field Approximately 2-4 years of hands-on software-development, data-engineering, application-development, or related technology experience Hands-on programming experience with Python, including functions, classes, exception handling, file and JSON processing, package usage, and automated testing Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data validation, and basic performance considerations Experience developing or integrating REST APIs and working with JSON-based request and response payloads Practical knowledge of AWS cloud services and serverless application patterns; exposure to AWS Bedrock is required or strongly preferred Understanding of Generative AI concepts such as prompts, tokens, embeddings, vector search, RAG, knowledge bases, model responses, and responsible AI safeguards Familiarity with Git-based source control, code reviews, defect tracking, testing, and CI/CD concepts Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate findings clearly, maintain documentation, and work collaboratively in a team environment Good written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies Experience using the AWS SDK for Python (Boto3) to integrate applications with AWS services. Exposure to AWS Bedrock model invocation, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents, or equivalent Generative AI capabilities Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or a comparable Python API framework. Exposure to PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or Amazon Aurora, including basic schema and query troubleshooting Familiarity with vector databases or semantic-search technologies such as Amazon OpenSearch or PostgreSQL with pgvector Understanding of document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, retrieval, source citations, and response validation Familiarity with Amazon CloudWatch logging and monitoring, IAM permissions, KMS encryption, and Secrets Manager Exposure to Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool, containerization, and automated deployment pipelines Experience or interest in banking, credit risk, financial services, or other regulated business domains Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Summary The Senior QA Engineer will own quality assurance for applications and data across Aon's Investment Consulting technology portfolio. This is an experienced, hands-on testing role focused on thorough manual testing: functional, regression, and integration testing, plus SQL-based data validation. The Senior QA Engineer will work closely with Aon's Eagle developers to test Eagle Pace customizations, data processing, and interfaces, as well as other backend, batch, and integration systems. Eagle Pace experience is a plus but not required; the successful candidate will be expected to learn Eagle and investment data on the job. We would also like to explore applying test automation to Eagle testing, so automation experience is preferred. Key Responsibilities Design, build and execute detailed test plans ,l test cases and test scripts for application enhancements, upgrades, defect fixes, and new functionality. Perform functional, regression, and integration testing across applications, batch processes, and system interfaces. Test Eagle Pace customizations, data processing, and interfaces in close partnership with Aon's Eagle developers. Validate data accuracy and completeness using SQL, including source-to-target checks and reconciliation of processed data. Test backend, batch, and integration processes, including inbound feeds, outbound extracts, and APIs. Work closely with developers and business analysts to understand requirements, design changes, and expected outcomes. Test toggle-based and configuration changes with flags on and off. Reproduce and help diagnose production issues, and contribute to incident analysis for the Investment applications we support. Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, and test evidence Support release validation, deployment activities, and post-release verification, coordinating with environment, release, and deployment teams to confirm environments are stable and ready Assist in production issue investigations and root cause analysis when required. Help explore opportunities to apply test automation to Eagle and data testing, and contribute to continuous improvement of QA practices, standards, and templates. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 6+ years of software quality assurance experience, working independently as a senior tester. Strong manual testing experience across functional, regression, and integration testing. Strong SQL skills for data validation and troubleshooting data issues. Experience testing backend, batch, data processing, or integration systems. Experience creating test plans ,test data and test cases, and managing defects through resolution. Experience working closely with developers within a delivery team. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Eagle Pace (Eagle Data Management) or other BNY Eagle products. Experience with investment data such as securities, holdings, transactions, and pricing. Experience supporting financial services, wealth management, retirement, or investment-related applications. Test automation experience; we would like to explore applying automation to Eagle testing. Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman). Experience working within Agile delivery environments. Experience using AI-assisted productivity and testing tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.
